title: Women's Softball: The Whole Road to College
title_html:
Women's Softball:
The Whole Road to College
rules_checked: 11 November 2026, against the NCAA rule text, the printed 2026-27 softball recruiting calendar, the NAIA and junior college rule books and the service pages quoted
levels: D1 and D2 and D3 and NAIA and junior college
kicker: Softball · girls and women · grades 9 to 12 · sport playbook
sub: What to do, when to do it, who pays, and what a coach is and is not allowed to tell you. Built from the 2026-27 NCAA rule text, the printed softball recruiting calendar with its dead periods and shutdowns, the NAIA and junior college rule books, and the camp and club prices a family actually sees.
edge: About 338,000 girls play high school softball and 21,916 play it in the NCAA, which is 6.5 percent. Softball is a spring sport, and its June recruiting dates move with the Women's College World Series, so the year a family is planning on is not always the year printed. This book shows which dates are printed, which are worked out from the rule, and which no association publishes at all.
